author: Dorey King Marcincuk
text: I was really upset recently. I'm not on blood sugar meds.  Its diet only for me.  My doctor recently put me on an antibiotic that lists low blood sugar as a side effect.   Low and behold,  my blood sugar dropped after starting the medication.  At first it went down into the normal range.  Then I started to get a few lows so I added some foods like rice and potatoes that I normal don't allow myself.  I had a slice of pizza.  With only a  day to go, I got an alarm. 52 with an arrow straight down.  At this point I said "no way I could be this low.  I don't feel impaired.  I got someone to check my blood sugar.  It was 147, not 52.  Who knows if the medication lowered my blood sugar at all.  I just spent two weeks eating carbs. Unless its ridiculously off, how do you trust it?
